name: SASP + Senescence Detection
starting_prompt: Detect senescent cells in my data

parameters.steps: SASP scoring (UCell) -> p16/p21 expression -> Senescent subpopulation

detailed_description:
SASP scoring + p16/p21 + senescent subpopulation

适用场景: aging, fibrosis

分析步骤:
  - SASP scoring (UCell): SASP signature scoring
  - p16/p21 expression: CDKN2A/CDKN1A analysis
  - Senescent subpopulation: High-score subpopulation ID

依赖包: UCell, Seurat, scanpy

难度: intermediate

触发提示: "Detect senescent cells in my data"
